title: Gibson Brite Wire Electric Bass Strings, Long Scale, Ultra-Light

long_description.body:
Developed under the direction of Gibson’s Master Luthiers, Gibson Brite Wire Electric Bass Strings feature a hex-shaped, tinned steel core precision-wound with nickel-plated steel for durability and powerful tone. Compared to pure nickel strings, nickel-plated steel strings are not only louder with increased treble, but the ferromagnetic property of steel results in stronger interaction with modern bass pickups. Made for a wide range of styles, Gibson Brite Wire Electric Bass Strings are factory-spec in the Gibson USA facility.



The hex-shaped, high-tensile tinned steel core provides strength and volume, while the nickel-plated steel wrap ensures superior sustain and crisp attack
Uncoated for authentic bass feel and sound
Developed and tested by Gibson Master Luthiers for all basses from the Gibson USA facility
Made in the USA
Long Scale, Ultra-Light Gauge: .045, .065, .080, .100
Long Scale, Light Gauge: .045, .065, .085, .105
Long Scale, Medium Gauge: .050, .070, .085, .105
Long Scale, 5-String, Light Gauge: .045, .065, .080, .100, .130
Short Scale, Light Gauge: .045, .065, .085, .105
Short Scale, Medium Gauge: .050, .070, .085, .105
